codeReview.summary: Implementation fully covers all required behaviors: debounced search (300ms), URL sync, prepopulation from URL, empty query suppression, results rendering with triple data, result navigation, and all UI states (loading, no results, error with retry). Tests are comprehensive (12 search-page tests, 7 search-input tests) and manual verification was thorough. Minor cosmetic inconsistency: Property ID column uses manual slicing while Entity ID uses TruncateId component.

issues.description: Property ID uses manual truncation (propertyId.slice(0, 12)...) while Entity ID uses the TruncateId component. For consistency, Property ID should also use TruncateId. This is a cosmetic inconsistency, not a functional bug.

summary: PASS. Clean implementation of search page with all required behaviors.
